{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(r'[^0-9.]', '', regex=True)
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
channel_revenue_sorted = channel_revenue.sort_values(by='revenue_clean', ascending=False)

# Print result
print(channel_revenue_sorted)"}
